title: After Totalitarianism: Museum, Memory and the Belarusian Perspective
description: An international academic and practical conference at the Free Belarus Museum, 8–9 October 2026. Andrei Arkhipenka represented the platform with a presentation on Taiwan’s memory culture.
body:
On 8–9 October 2026, Warsaw hosted the international conference “After Totalitarianism: Museum, Memory and the Belarusian Perspective”, organised by the Free Belarus Museum.

Belarus–Taiwan & East Asia Platform was represented by its founder and researcher Andrei Arkhipenka. His presentation focused on Taiwan’s memory culture.
